name: Chiemsee Camping Rödlgries
beschreibung: The campsite Chiemsee Camping Rödlgries is located in Übersee, Tirol, directly on the shore of Chiemsee. The location at the foot of the mountains provides access to extensive hiking trails and cycling routes in the nature region. The facilities of the campsite include pitches, rental apartments, modern sanitary facilities, a restaurant and a kiosk. A private swimming area and a playground are available on the grounds. In winter, the surrounding ski areas of the Kitzbüheler Alpen and the Kaisergebirge offer runs for winter sports enthusiasts. Guests can expect a well-developed infrastructure for a stay by the lake in the mountains of Tirol.
